jobs.prompt: Item R: integrate records content hashes so the hand-build guard can tell a swarm-written file from a hand-edited one. (1) In tools/swarm.mjs, at both places where a run is integrated (the plain integrate path that sets state.integratedAt and state.integratedFiles, and the merge-queue path that pushes to state.integratedFiles and state.integratedNewFiles), after the files have been written to the project, compute the sha256 (hex) of each integrated file's bytes as it is on disk and store state.integratedHashes as an object mapping the project-relative path to that hash (merge with any hashes already there from earlier attempts of the same run; a path integrated twice keeps the latest). Never fail the integration because hashing failed: on an error skip that path. Keep every existing field. (2) tools/swarm-produced.mjs: keep swarmProducedFiles(root) returning the Set of paths, and add swarmProducedHashes(root) returning a Map from path to a Set of sha256 hex strings, built from the same validated runs (regular state.json files in regular run folders whose id equals the folder name, with integratedAt set) and only from integratedHashes; a run without integratedHashes contributes no hashes. Add isSwarmProducedContent(root, rel, bytes) returning true only when the sha256 of bytes is in that file's hash set (fail closed: a file with no recorded hash is not swarm-produced). (3) tools/handbuild.mjs: wherever the guard judges whether a file is swarm-produced (the gitCarryOk check for git add, git commit and for what a push carries), use the content hash: for a commit judge the staged content (git show :PATH read with a 3 second timeout, falling back to not swarm-produced on any error), for git add judge the working tree file bytes, for a push judge each file's content at the pushed commit (git show HEAD:PATH or the files in git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD read at HEAD); a routing path stays free without a hash; a file whose hash does not match (hand-edited after integrate, or an older run without hashes) needs an approval naming the file. Update the existing tests that built fake swarm-produced state without hashes (tests/handbuild-allowlist.test.mjs, tests/handbuild-hardening.test.mjs, tests/handbuild-hardening2.test.mjs, tests/handbuild-guard.test.mjs) so their fake state.json files carry integratedHashes that match the fixture file bytes. New tests in tests/integrate-hashes.test.mjs (integrate a tiny fixture run through the real integrate function the way existing integrate tests do, then assert state.json has integratedHashes with the right sha256 for each written file, and that a second attempt keeps hashes) and tests/swarm-produced-hash.test.mjs (hash match is swarm-produced; the same path with one byte changed is not; a run with no integratedHashes is not; a symlinked state.json is ignored; a commit carrying a swarm file whose staged bytes were hand-edited needs an approval while the unedited one is allowed). Write only tools/swarm.mjs, tools/swarm-produced.mjs, tools/handbuild.mjs and those test files.
